Design preview — Machines (new Inbox design)

The Machines page now uses the approved option A "Inbox" layout: a 280 px machine list and one detail pane. All captures come from the real Electron build of branch feat/reviews-machines-inbox-layout.

Sample data. The populated captures use SAMPLE DATA. The capture script puts four sample machines, three sample sessions, one waiting tool approval and one readiness result into the real MachinesStore and readiness panel. The sample machines do not exist in the backend, so the script also clears the real "not found" error of the session list. The error state uses a sample error message. The layout, components and styles are the real build.

Remaining differences from the prototype

  1. The app shows its top navigation bar and the Workspaces and Git rails around the page. The prototype shows only the page.
  2. The app uses the glass theme surfaces (rounded panes, gold primary action). The prototype uses plain DaisyUI surfaces with a blue primary action.
  3. Not a chrome or theme difference, open: the approval card uses the block of the session view ("Waiting for you", a table with machine, tool and arguments, "Denied automatically in 42 s"). The prototype shows a compact card ("Approval waiting", "42 s left of 60 s"). The built card has the "Allow once" and "Deny" actions.
  4. Not a chrome or theme difference, open: small text differences. The header line shows "via SSH alias build" (prototype: "ssh: build").
  5. Not a chrome or theme difference, open: the closed Readiness tile shows the result ("7 of 7 passed") only after the first check of the machine in this visit. Before that, it shows its description line. The prototype shows the result immediately. An automatic check on machine change needs a follow-up task.
